title: One Open Term per Named Insured: Named Non-Owner Policy Holding Limits
content:
**Rule.** A named insured may hold only 1 Named Non-Owner Policy term that is open — bound, in force or pending cancellation. A term with the status renewal offered replaces its expiring term and does not count separately.

**Conditions at binding (read from the company's records, not from the caller's account):**

1. The named insured must not already hold an open Named Non-Owner Policy term. The test is made on the terms recorded for that named insured.
2. A Named Non-Owner Policy is not bound while the named insured holds an open Owner Auto Policy term, read from the Owner Auto Policy terms recorded for the same named insured.

Owning a vehicle and holding an owner policy are mutually exclusive with this product. The only overlap allowed is the conversion day, on which the non-owner term is cancelled effective the owner term's effective date.

| Records show | New Named Non-Owner Policy term |
|---|---|
| an in-force Named Non-Owner Policy term for the named insured | not bound |
| a pending-cancellation Named Non-Owner Policy term | not bound (open) |
| only an expiring term and its renewal-offered term | the renewal-offered term does not count separately |
| an open Owner Auto Policy term | not bound |

*Hypothetical:* a named insured whose only Named Non-Owner Policy term expired last month holds no open term on that account; whether they hold an open Owner Auto Policy term is the second test.
